test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the idiom that gives the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase in the following sentence.**

My neighbour **__has decided__** to join the air force.
solution:
The correct answer is** "​Made up his mind​."****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom that gives the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase **"has decided"** in the sentence is **"Made up his mind."**
 
• This idiom means to reach a decision or conclusion after careful consideration. (गहन विचार-विमर्श के बाद किसी निर्णय या निष्कर्ष पर पहुँचना)
 
• In the context of the sentence, it suggests that the neighbor has come to a definite decision to join the air force after considering various factors.
 
 
• **Example**: *After considering all his options, he finally **made up his mind**__ to pursue a career in medicine.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Made his own way: **someone forging their own path or achieving success through their own efforts and decisions, especially when faced with challenges or adversity. (कोई अपना रास्ता खुद बना रहा है या अपने प्रयासों और निर्णयों के माध्यम से सफलता प्राप्त कर रहा है, खासकर जब चुनौतियों या प्रतिकूल परिस्थितियों का सामना करना पड़ता है)
 
• **Made a fuss: **to react or behave in an exaggerated or excessive manner, often by complaining, protesting, or causing unnecessary agitation or commotion about something. (अतिरंजित या अत्यधिक तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया करना या व्यवहार करना, अक्सर शिकायत करना, विरोध करना, या किसी चीज़ के बारे में अनावश्यक उत्तेजना या हंगामा पैदा करना)
 
• **Made a clean sweep: **to achieve a complete or comprehensive victory or success, often by thoroughly addressing or resolving a situation or by winning decisively in a competition or endeavor. (पूर्ण या व्यापक जीत या सफलता प्राप्त करना, अक्सर किसी स्थिति को पूरी तरह से संबोधित करके या हल करके या किसी प्रतियोगिता या प्रयास में निर्णायक रूप से जीतकर)
